scope_note: Media upload pipeline — multipart upload to MinIO/S3, BullMQ variant generation job
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/admin/media/upload accepts multipart/form-data and stores original in MinIO
BullMQ job generates image variants (thumbnail, medium) after upload
Upload returns media record with status 'processing' immediately
Media status transitions to 'ready' once variants are generated
